SELECT s.id, s.name, m.type AS merchantType, s.longitude, s.latitude, f.url AS coverImageUrl, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coupon c WHERE c.store_id = s.id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.valid_from <= NOW() AND c.valid_to >= NOW() ) AS hasCoupon FROM store s INNER JOIN merchant m ON s.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN stored_file f ON s.cover_image_file_id = f.id WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.business_status = 'OPEN'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM poi p WHERE p.store_id = s.id AND p.street_area_id = #{streetAreaId} AND p.poi_type = 'STORE' AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' )
ORDER BY s.id ASC LIMIT 50
SELECT sa.id, sa.longitude, sa.latitude FROM street_area sa WHERE sa.id = #{streetAreaId} AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
